title: Speedrunning 30yrs of lithography technology
summary: Breaking Taps tries to build semiconductor fabrication capability at home, working through decades of lithography history while chasing one-micrometer features. It documents the equipment, process steps and many setbacks along the way.
why: HN points to it as an example of hobbyist, at-home integrated circuit fabrication.

quote.text: Here is BreakingTaps fabricating home made chips, he has a fair bit of equipment though
